integrity: All analytic/geometric inputs and elementary arithmetic steps are stated; no independent mathematical validation has occurred. Reproducible exact-integer supplemental checks are embedded.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the rank-two transcendental specialization in the Y2 degeneration of Arapura--Greer--Zhang, not to the full integral cohomology cokernel. The proof uses characteristic-zero Weierstrass theory, published fiber data and the published isometric injection. Priority of the K3 lattice isometry is not independently established.
title: Two independent mod-two transcendental specialization obstructions in an elliptic-surface degeneration
